sources.title: 210-RICR-50-00-7, Involuntary Discharge from a Long-Term Care Facility — PDF linked from rules.sos.ri.gov/regulations/part/210-50-00-7
sources.source_date: Regulation Effective Date 01/04/2022 (Periodic Refile; original E-SIGNED December 15, 2021)
sources.notes: The regulation's own PDF, the 'Download Regulation' file linked from rules.sos.ri.gov/regulations/part/210-50-00-7, fetched by plain curl from the Department of State's public S3 bucket (200, no user-agent needed). Routed here on owner decision FA-D-20261025-02 (FA-Q-20260927-02): the rules.sos.ri.gov page renders each section as <section class="doc-block" style="display: none;"> opened by an onclick on its heading, which capture.py rightly treats as hidden, so an html-text capture of that page keeps only the section headings. pdftotext-layout, not -raw: with -raw four page quotations broke on line joins; -layout matched every one. Captured whole; the file name changes when the regulation is refiled, which is the supersession signal for this source. Verified 2026-10-25: two captures byte-identical, 0 fidelity failures on both surfaces.
